content.text: {"customer_value_line":"Store managers see on hand including open orders within minutes, so Northwind stops shipping to stores that are already full.","rows":[{"milestone":"Apex sends the change feed setup doc for Carlos's ops runbook","customer_owner":"Carlos Mendes","apex_owner":"Devon Clarke","target_date":"2026-09-28","status":"agreed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U020","excerpt":"I want the change feed setup written down for our ops runbook."},{"utterance_id":"U021","excerpt":"I'll send you the setup doc today."}]},{"milestone":"Apex sends business case numbers for Priscilla: cost per store and the overstock reduction modeled together","customer_owner":"Maya Lindqvist","apex_owner":"Hannah Ortiz","target_date":"2026-10-02","status":"agreed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U016","excerpt":"Can you have that to me by Friday, October 2nd?"},{"utterance_id":"U017","excerpt":"Yes, I'll send it by Friday the 2nd."}]},{"milestone":"30 minute meeting with Priscilla (CFO) with Hannah and Devon attending","customer_owner":"Maya Lindqvist","apex_owner":"Hannah Ortiz","target_date":"2026-10-06","status":"agreed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U018","excerpt":"I'll set up 30 minutes with her for Tuesday, October 6th at 10."},{"utterance_id":"U019","excerpt":"I'll be there with Devon."}]},{"milestone":"Maya shares Priscilla's email, adds Hannah and Devon to the invite, and says what Priscilla needs to approve a purchase over 200 thousand","customer_owner":"Maya Lindqvist","apex_owner":"Hannah Ortiz","target_date":"2026-09-29","status":"proposed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U014","excerpt":"She's our CFO and she signs anything over 200 thousand."}]},{"milestone":"Decision and paper process (approval, legal, procurement) identified after the CFO meeting","customer_owner":"Maya Lindqvist","apex_owner":"Hannah Ortiz","target_date":"","status":"proposed","evidence":[{"utterance_id":"U014","excerpt":"She's our CFO and she signs anything over 200 thousand."}]}]}
